_comment: Wan2.2-I2V-A14B workload identity for results dirs and reports. Shape block and reference_totals_per_block are currently aligned to configs/escher_14b_480p.json (same DiT surrogate) until a Wan-specific op table and calibration are integrated.
name: wan2_2_i2v_a14b

model._calibration_note: These shapes were tuned to land per-block totals within a few percent of the PDF reference (4641.7 GFLOPs / 3070.2 MB HBM). If your real escher_14b_480p uses different shapes, edit this block and re-run benchmarks/bench04_workload_ops.py — the `calibration_drift` field in ops.json must be |drift| < 5% before the benchmark signs off.

reference_totals_per_block._note: Per the PDF op table. If your shape/depth produce totals more than 5% off, recalibrate the shape spec before signing off the benchmark.

source_pilot_reference._note: Source-pilot headline numbers (Odyssey AMD Inference Pilot, April 2026). Any benchmark or report that quotes 'the source PDF says X' must read X from this block; nothing in the pipeline should hardcode pilot-specific values. bench05 reads pdf_reference_targets_pct from here and emits it into mfu.json; the report's 'Reference vs Observed' and 'Reproduction vs Source PDF' sections read peak_tflops / ici_ring_gb_s / memory_bw_to_ici_ratio from here.
